headline: CVS Health Plans Split into Two Publicly Traded Companies by 2028
summary: CVS Health is reportedly planning to separate its business into two distinct publicly traded companies by 2028. The move aims to restructure the healthcare giant's operations.
why: CVS Health is a major US pharmacy chain and healthcare provider. Corporate splits are often pursued to unlock shareholder value by separating distinct business units with different growth profiles.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: Corporate restructuring plans are often viewed positively by investors seeking value realization.
